releases.name: v1.3.0
releases.body:
## What's Changed

**[NEW] AI Policy Content Additions**
_Added new AI Usage guidance to CONTRIBUTING.md and new AI Usage section to PR templates_
* Adding AI Usage Section to CONTRIBUTING.md by @sachin-panayil in https://github.com/DSACMS/repo-scaffolder/pull/394
* Added AI usage section to PR template by @kmsheikh in https://github.com/DSACMS/repo-scaffolder/pull/396
* Added AI usage section to tier 2, 3, and 4 PR templates by @kmsheikh in https://github.com/DSACMS/repo-scaffolder/pull/398
* Templates: Fix typo in PR templates by @natalialuzuriaga in https://github.com/DSACMS/repo-scaffolder/pull/402

**GitHub Repository Topics**
_Added ability to add repository topics during repository creation_
* Add GitHub repository topic prompts and automatic topic assignment` by @isaac-rtc in https://github.com/DSACMS/repo-scaffolder/pull/395

**Outbound Checklists**
_Included installation instructions and removed outdated content_
* Outbound Checklists and Docs: Add instructions for installing dependencies by @natalialuzuriaga in https://github.com/DSACMS/repo-scaffolder/pull/400

**Housekeeping**
_code.json is fully up-to-date, fixed workflows identified by CodeQL warnings_
* Update code.json by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/DSACMS/repo-scaffolder/pull/397
* Update maturity-model-tiers.md by @decause-gov in https://github.com/DSACMS/repo-scaffolder/pull/384
* Release: Merging Dev to Main by @natalialuzuriaga in https://github.com/DSACMS/repo-scaffolder/pull/404
* Workflows: Specify permissions for various workflows by @natalialuzuriaga in https://github.com/DSACMS/repo-scaffolder/pull/403


## New Contributors
* @kmsheikh made their first contribution in https://github.com/DSACMS/repo-scaffolder/pull/396
* @isaac-rtc made their first contribution in https://github.com/DSACMS/repo-scaffolder/pull/395

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/DSACMS/repo-scaffolder/compare/v1.2.1...v1.3.0
